stem:
The table shows x-values and y-values for a number pattern.

| x  | y  |
|----|----|
| 12 | 18 |
| 24 | 30 |
| 48 | 54 |
| 60 | 66 |

Which statement is true?

options.label: F
options.text: The pattern is multiplicative, because the y-values are 1.5 times the corresponding x-values.

options.label: G
options.text: The pattern is multiplicative, because the y-values are 6 more than the corresponding x-values.

options.label: H
options.text: The pattern is additive, because the y-values are 1.5 times the corresponding x-values.

options.label: J
options.text: The pattern is additive, because the y-values are 6 more than the corresponding x-values.

visual_elements: table with columns x and y showing values (12,18), (24,30), (48,54), (60,66)
